evidence: A halide-free organometallic compound, bis( tert-butylimido)-bis(dimethylamido)molybdenum, and ammonia were used as precursors. Nitrogen (AGA, 99.999% N 2) served as purge and carrier gas. Ammonia (AGA, 99.995% NH3) flow was fixed at 100 standard cubic centimeters per minute (sccm) and the nitrogen flow at 400 sccm.
